status: P2-P8 statically identified and resolved against GTBikeV.dll 0.8.0.4 by reflection (Test-BindingResolve.ps1, Test-WorldBindings.ps1). P2 validated in GTA V (R1-R5, 2026-11-05); P3-P8 pending in game.

match.rule: Profile is selected only when the version matches AND every 'required' binding below resolves with the exact CLR type. Any other version: reads only if they pass the same checks; all writes blocked.

threading: All reads and invocations run on the adapter's SHVDN Tick. HTTP, FIT parsing and disk I/O never touch these members.

bindings.mapping: powerW; -1 or !IsDTOK -> null/unavailable; 0 is valid
speedMps; returns -1 when !IsDTOK -> null/unavailable
speedMps.source = virtual when true
cadenceRpm; 255 -> null/unavailable
heartRateBpm; 255, 0 or no present heartRate sensor -> null/unavailable
distanceM; resets with session
ridingTimeMs (not moving time)
slopeFraction; getter already maps -9999.9 sentinel to 0, so 0 is ambiguous: quality valid only when IsDTOK
windSpeedMps = kmh / 3.6
windDirRad (relative)
sport by enum NAME, never by integer

runtimeChecklist: R1 Adapter resolves every required P2 binding with the exact CLR type on 0.8.0.4 and reports bindingProfile=gtbikev-0804.
R2 ANTStatus/BLEStatus names read by reflection match the 8 ReceiverState names through activate -> ready -> deactivate -> stopped.
R3 Multiplayer.CurrentActivity is non-null while riding after activation and null after deactivation.
R4 GetCurrentDeviceFor at 1 Hz on READY receivers does not drop frames or throw; heartRate absent -> present=false.
R5 Deactivation via menu item: measure how many Ticks the adapter is blocked (Script.Yield loop) and confirm the bridge marks the snapshot stale, not live.
R6 mod.setActive(true) while a receiver is 'started' is rejected with MOD_TRANSITION_IN_PROGRESS and does not call the handler.
R7 With a PC-started workout, Activity.Workout != null and Finished=false are observed (guard input for later phases).
